digest.component_or_area: GitHub Actions workflows / core bridge push integration
propositions: Migrate both reconcile-bridge and reconcile-bridge-canary workflows from inline CAS loops to strict synchronous core push entrypoints
Reconciler workflow must preserve exact bot identity, commit subject, and author metadata while delegating retry/CAS recovery to core
Canary workflow must invoke rebar._store.push with strict synchronous behavior and no inline fetch/merge/retry
Ensure workflows remain red on delivery failure and that Python library and MCP retain best-effort defaults
Remove raw-git reconciler exemption and replace synthetic test rationale with generic reviewed-workflow wording
Verify backward compatibility: rollback requires only reverting workflow call sites with no data migration needed
